text: No, God don't give me no pennies there, Jesus Christ. I don't know about that. No. By God, I ain't got a goddamn penny in there either. Here, take a couple. No, no, no, no, I don't want any of those goddamn things. No, I don't want pennies there, Luke. No, not there. Me and Luke went round and round already on the pennies, haven't we, Luke? Oh, we don't get very excited about it.
